sections.content: You know *quizás* and *dudo que* with the subjunctive from B1 Unit 13 (*subjunctive-doubt*). This lesson adds *es posible que* and *puede que*, which present something as uncertain, and shows *quizá* beside them.

items.english: It is possible that he/she will arrive late.

items.spanish: Quizá el problema sea más complicado de lo que parece.
items.english: Perhaps the problem is more complicated than it seems.

sections.content: *Quizá* is flexible: it takes the subjunctive when the speaker is unsure (*Quizá tengan razón*) and can take the indicative when the speaker feels more confident. *Es posible que* and *puede que* always take the subjunctive.
